Invented timetable and GTFS Realtime snapshots for beta browser tests only. Never served by the production application. 8 November 2026: Ghent → Brussels → Liège, IC 502/503/504 and P8008. IC 502 is delayed; IC 504 canceled. P8009 runs only on 9 November, allowing autocomplete to check the selected service day.

`headsigns.arrow` provides Dutch/German/English destination translations. The
English translation of Liège-Guillemins is intentionally absent to cover the
fallback to the published headsign.
